summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on PR #416, then switch to a docs branch to audit and update project planning documents (DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md) and create a new filesystem specification.
summary.outcome: PR #416 review comments were resolved and merged to main. A docs PR (#419) was created on branch `docs/update-project-documentation` with updated planning docs, a new FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md, and a thoroughly audited DEFERRED.md with phases 38 and 39 added to the roadmap.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the chosen observability/error tracking solution — not Sentry, Datadog, or Loki.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 functions actually used) are deprecated but not yet retired — Phase 38 target.
Desktop FUSE layer is intentionally not unit tested; it is thin OS plumbing covered by the Desktop E2E suite instead.
Vault v1 legacy columns were removed when staging was reset; the full schema baseline (1700000000000-FullSchema.ts) was written after that reset and never included them.

@cipherbox/crypto has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency only for a single test (vault-ipns.test.ts) that compares key derivation — a leftover from the restructuring phase, targeted for cleanup in Phase 38.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — user-configurable bin retention is still deferred (Phase 39).
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy product.
pin:secondaryFailed event was implemented in Phase 37 as part of the batch upload pipeline.
Per-file IPNS conflict detection has been implemented since Phase 12.6.
The Copilot review comment about lazy file reads in useDropUpload.ts:140 was a duplicate of CodeRabbit thread 8 from the first review round, already tracked as a deferred item in 37-CONTEXT.md.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw synchronously, leaking entries from the pending map — fixed with try/catch that deletes the pending entry on error.
JSDoc comment on uploadFiles() overstated memory bounding — corrected to accurately describe actual buffering behavior.
Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — architectural limitation requiring SDK API change (accept File objects or read callback instead of Uint8Array); deferred, not a bug fix.
Sole consumer of the @cipherbox/core devDependency in the crypto package — test could use hardcoded vectors instead; circular devDep removal targeted for Phase 38.

workflow: When asked to audit a list for stale items, do a systematic pass of every single item against the codebase — not just the ones explicitly called out by the user.
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation can batch multiple thread resolutions; REST endpoint requires --field (integer) not -f for in_reply_to parameter.
Pre-existing integration test failures (live API tests requiring a running backend) should be distinguished from new failures before committing.
Planning documents (DEFERRED.md especially) drift quickly — items get implemented across phases without the deferred list being updated, requiring periodic full audits.

friction: Multiple rounds needed to properly audit DEFERRED.md — initial pass was shallow and only removed items explicitly called out by the user rather than doing a full systematic review.
Remote log shipping item was left in DEFERRED.md even though Grafana Faro was identified as already implemented — required another user prompt to catch.
DTS circular dependency was prematurely removed from DEFERRED.md before confirming with user whether it was intentional; had to be re-added.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS was initially miscategorized as implementing the user-configurable retention deferred item, when it is actually an operator env var — corrected after user pushback.
Edit tool reformatted table widths requiring a raw bash cat workaround to read exact file content before making targeted edits.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 used functions) by migrating callers to SDK methods; also remove @cipherbox/crypto devDependency on @cipherbox/core by refactoring vault-ipns.test.ts to use hardcoded test vectors.
Phase 39: Add user-configurable vault parameters — specifically allowing end users to set their own recycle bin retention period (distinct from the operator-level RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var).
Lazy file reading in useDropUpload.ts (batch reads all files to memory before SDK call) requires a breaking SDK API change to accept File objects or a read callback instead of Uint8Array.
docs/update-project-documentation PR #419 is open and needs review/merge.
